outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL GAME SPRITE SHEET, three independent transparent fog layers for a high-fidelity pixel-art 2.5D miniature planet game. The reference image is ONLY the existing game palette, light direction and pixel density, do not include the planet or terrain. Create a tall canvas divided into THREE EQUAL HORIZONTAL ROWS with generous transparent separation. Each row contains ONE low horizontal bank of alien purple-pink star mist, all three rows aligned centered and similar width, no ground or objects. TOP ROW: distant dark indigo-violet rounded billows, subtle mauve tops and warm amber reflected light along lower-left base, soft contour defined with deliberate stepped pixel clusters. MIDDLE ROW: opaque rich lilac/mauve rolling middle cloud, scalloped overlapping voluminous lobes, pink-lavender upper edges, deep blue-violet cores, richly organized pixel shading. BOTTOM ROW: a shallower crescent-like front rim of luminous pink-violet mist with an open transparent middle/back, a few small flowing curls and fine warm golden reflected pixels. These will be combined as BACK / MAIN / FRONT layers in Canvas, so there must be no labels, no UI, no stars beyond each cloud, no geometric polygons, no blurred photographic smoke, no ground shadows, no rectangle gradient plates. Fine production-quality pixel painting at roughly 320-pixel native sprite width per cloud, nearest-neighbor visibly stepped edges. A cloud must feel like cool mysterious luminous volume touching a warm orange miniature world. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the mist, no checkerboard painted into the image.
